we have proposed a new transfer learning algorithm that is based on a boosting framework and that we have theoretically and empirically analyzed and shown the effectiveness of our proposed method.

we have extended the TrAdaBoost algorithm and improved its classification performance using a correction factor that is based on the dynamic factor.

extending and improving the boosting based transfer learning methods.
the development and analysis of boosting based transfer learning algorithms.
addressing some of the weaknesses in the existing boosting based transfer learning algorithms and we provide a new framework that can be used as a base for future transfer learning research.

our proposed framework, TrAdaBoost+, is an improved version of TrAdaBoost which is able to achieve better classification results in a wide variety of scenarios.
the proposed method is a general framework for improving the performance of transfer learning algorithms.

our framework is an important step in boosting the performance of transfer learning algorithms and it is a step towards the development of a more effective transfer learning algorithm that is capable of incorporating the advantages from both AdaBoost and "Weighted Majority".
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a novel framework that is able to improve the classification results of TrAdaBoost by dynamically adjusting the weight of each example during the training process.

we have developed a framework for improving the classification performance of transfer learning algorithms by incorporating dynamic factors that adaptively change the learning parameters during the learning process.
the proposed algorithm is more effective than TrAdaBoost and other state of the art boosting methods for transfer learning.

the proposed framework can be used to improve the performance of any instance based transfer learning algorithm that is based on the TrAdaBoost algorithm.
the proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art boosting transfer learning algorithms on several real world data sets.
the dynamic factor plays a key role in boosting based transfer learning algorithms and can be used to improve the classification performance of such algorithms.
